requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 每秒串口输出 A0 电位器值 和 D2 按钮状态
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Drive io_0 to a sequence of values and toggle io_1 (button pressed/released) at arbitrary times; advance io_2 with 10ms deltas continuously and observe serial_0_trigger events once per elapsed second.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: At each 1-second report gate step (serial_0_trigger true), serial_0_value_0 equals the latest io_0 at that step and serial_0_value_1 equals the latest io_1 at that step; between gates serial_0_trigger is false.
